definition.name: epsilon-banach-cstar-norm-axioms
definition.definition: Byte-matched from refs/kitaev-2405.02434/approximate_algebras.tex (tex:408-436): ||XY|| <= (1+\eps)||X|| ||Y||; ||(XY)Z-X(YZ)|| <= \eps||X|| ||Y|| ||Z||; ||X^\dag||=||X||, (XY)^\dag=Y^\dag X^\dag; ||X^\dag X|| >= (1-\eps)||X||^2; unit approx or exact; I^\dag=I.
